TOPIC: Idempotency keys for agent tool calls
KEY POINTS: Agents retried tool calls after timeouts and created duplicate records. Fix: hash of tool name + arguments stored before returning; retries resume instead of repeating.

TOPIC: Separating transport retries from business retries
KEY POINTS: Two retry layers caused confusing duplication. Transport retries are automatic and safe; business retries need an explicit decision and persisted state.

TOPIC: What broke first in our Python workflow automation
KEY POINTS: Scheduler overlap created concurrent runs. A claim table with SKIP LOCKED plus explicit status transitions fixed it.

TOPIC: A practical checklist before shipping an AI workflow
KEY POINTS: Validate inputs at the boundary; store every step outcome; make side effects idempotent; surface typed failures; keep a human in the loop for irreversible actions.
